title: personal kpi weekly checkin - riley james - 2026-03-02
content:
Quick weekly check-in / scratchpad for KPIs and action items. Mostly notes to self - TODOs and things to follow up on.

Context:
- Role: eng-serving-runtime (individual contributor) working on batching/kv-cache/quantization pipeline.
- Focus this quarter: reduce per-token cost and improve 95th pct latency for hosted-api routes.

Top-level metrics (current running totals / targets):
- Route: /v1/generate (customer-facing)
  - Weekly requests: ~48k (target 60k by EOY)
  - Avg tokens/request: 220
  - Cost per 1k tokens (hosted mix): $0.32 (goal: $0.25)
  - p50 latency: 110ms, p95: 430ms (target p95 < 300ms)
- KV cache hit rate (all routes): 28% (target 45%)
- Batching efficiency (tokens per batch): 1.9 -> aim for 2.5
- Regression alerts: none this week (good)

This week's wins / notes:
- Small change in batcher scheduling reduced queuing jitter for short sequences (experiment A). p50 improved ~8ms on internal perf harness. Need to run more canary traffic.
- Disabled eager quantize job for one model variant during peak; saw slight reduction in tail latency. Might be noise - add metric tag and re-run with longer window.
- Paired with Samira on a rough rollout plan for cache warmup on Dedicated. Draft PR: github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2743 (need to add test coverage).

Open questions / uncertainties:
- How to prioritize batch size vs latency target for premium customers? If we push batching to improve cost, we may violate p95 SLO for small requests. Consider policy: route-level SLO override for <50ms required requests.
- Impact of new kernel selection heuristic (A/B variant) on 2k-seqlen tails - data inconclusive. Need to run with real traffic slice (10%?): link to experiment in Linear INF-987.

Action items (this week):
- [ ] Launch canary for batcher-scheduling change on staging -> prod-canary (owner: Riley) - target by 2026-03-04.
- [ ] Add logging for quantize job decisions (Samira) and tag runs with commit SHA.
- [ ] Follow up with console team to get per-route token breakdown exported to S3 (Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/infra/pages/Batching+Metrics).
- [ ] Update PR #2743 to include unit test for cache warmup flow.
- [ ] Draft a short note for ENG-ALL about expected behavior during rollout (include rollback steps).

Notes to self (brainstorm / rough):
- Consider soft-alloc slots for premium routes: small dedicated micro-batches that bypass the normal batching queue to keep p95 low. Implementation idea: ephemeral priority queue + token cap per slot.
- Evaluate using predictive prefix caching for top 20 heavy routes (model-by-route). Use historical prefix histogram from last 30 days.
- Cost modeling: simulate cost tradeoff of batching increase vs cache hit improvement. Build small notebook (sheet) with parameters: batch_size, cache_hit, latency_penalty.

Linked artifacts / refs:
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-452 (batcher scheduling improvement)
- Linear: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/INF-987 (kernel selection experiment)
- GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/2743
- Confluence notes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/infra/pages/Batching+Metrics

Collaborators to ping this week: Samira Patel, Hunter Ellis, Maya Singh (for console exports).

Status: draft - will convert to in_review once PRs merged and canary completed.

Random personal TODOs (non-blocking):
- Refill standing coffee pod supply.
- Push calendar block for deep work on Friday afternoon (no meetings).

End of note.
